PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "I1":    (16e-6, 6e-6, 24e-6),
    "Isf":   (16e-6, 6e-6, 22e-6),
    "gmid_sf": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "Rf":    (140e3, 128e3, 200e3),
    "Cf":    (12e-15, 1e-15, 40e-15),
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    I1, Isf, Rf, Cf = p["I1"], p["Isf"], p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    Ipb = 4e-6                       # PMOS bias branch

    # Gain device M1: gate = input (DC = vout via Rf), drain = x
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.3)
    vout_dc = m1.vgs
    # Source follower x -> vout (bulk at vss, so it sees body effect)
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], 0.15, Isf, vds=VDD - vout_dc, vsb=vout_dc)
    vx = vout_dc + msf.vgs
    vds_p = max(VDD - vx, 0.2)
    # PMOS load mirror (diode branch + load) with the same gm/Id and L
    gmid_p = 10.0
    mpl = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I1, vds=vds_p)
    mpd = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=vds_p)
    # NMOS mirror off ibias: reference, follower tail, PMOS-bias sink
    gmid_n, Ln = 10.0, 1.0
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Ln, iref, vds=0.65)
    mtail = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Ln, Isf, vds=vout_dc)
    mnb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, Ln, Ipb, vds=VDD - mpd.vgs)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MTAIL", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtail)
    n.dev("MNB", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MPL", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpl)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- small-signal 3-node model: in, x, out ----
    cgd1 = m1.cgd
    cin = cpd + max(m1.cgg - cgd1, 0.0)
    cx = m1.cdd + mpl.cdd + msf.cgd
    cgs_sf = max(msf.cgg - msf.cgd, 0.0)
    co = cl + mtail.cdd
    gx = m1.gds + mpl.gds
    go = msf.gds + mtail.gds
    G = 1.0 / Rf

    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Y = np.array([
            [s*(cin + cgd1 + Cf) + G, -s*cgd1, -(G + s*Cf)],
            [m1.gm - s*cgd1, gx + s*(cx + cgd1 + cgs_sf), -s*cgs_sf],
            [-(G + s*Cf), -msf.gm - s*cgs_sf,
             msf.gm + msf.gmbs + go + s*(co + cgs_sf) + G + s*Cf]], dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(Y, np.array([1.0, 0, 0], dtype=complex))
        return v[2]

    z0 = abs(zt(1e3))
    freqs = np.logspace(4, 10, 1500)
    f3 = freqs[-1]
    for f in freqs:
        if abs(zt(f)) < z0 / math.sqrt(2):
            f3 = f
            break

    # ---- input-referred noise at 1 MHz ----
    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    gam = 0.8
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    yin2 = G**2 + (w * (cin + Cf + cgd1))**2
    vn2 = kT4 * gam * (m1.gm + mpl.gm) / m1.gm**2
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + vn2 * yin2
    power = VDD * (iref + Ipb + I1 + Isf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout_dc,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
    }
